## Summary

P26.6 — **agenda content depth: index records → typed claims** (ticket
`docs/tickets/P26.6__agenda-content-claims.md`, SOURCES.6), stacked on
`devin/p26-5-vendor-tenant-universe` (PR #97).

The P26.5 tenant sweep produced 665 captured agenda-platform index payloads
emitting `agenda_index` records. This ticket turns those index rows into
document-level evidence: each captured index fans out into its linked
agenda/minutes/matter documents under a reviewed bounded window, a reviewed
surveillance-content vocabulary scans the captured text, and matches emit
typed `content_term` claims whose `raw_value` is a verbatim slice of the
captured document located by a byte_range/page locator — the OKC document
convention, fail-closed on drift.

## What changed

### Bounded document continuation (`connectors/procurement.py`)

- `discover_more` resolves document targets off captured index payloads —
  Legistar `{api_base}/matters/{MatterId}`, CivicClerk `/v1/Meetings/{agendaId}`,
  eScribe `Meeting.aspx?Id={ID}`, PrimeGov's own
  `itemsSearchResultsDefaultLinkOnMeetingPortal` payload field (the URL comes
  from captured data, never constructed).
- The window is **data, not code**: `doc_per_tenant`, `doc_run_cap`, and
  `doc_order_fields` ride `[platform_endpoints.*]` rows in
  `procurement_vocab.toml` onto every generated tenant target. Tier-0
  (vocab-/contract-type items) first, then canonical recency order.
- `parse` dispatches resolved `agenda_document` targets through
  `_parse_agenda_document` — genre re-derived from captured bytes; wrong
  genre, error envelopes, or missing `doc_required_fields` is `ContentDrift`
  per document (the run continues; a seed drift still fails the run).
- `scan_agenda_content` compiles the 15 reviewed terms of
  `agenda_content_vocab.toml` (alpr/flock/vigilant/rtcc/drone/shotspotter/
  surveillance_ordinance/facial_recognition/body_worn_camera/cctv/
  cell_site_simulator/predictive_policing/gunshot_detection/
  social_media_monitoring/contract_notice) — verbatim literals only, sorted
  deterministically, Part VIII forbidden-token suppressions recorded on the
  document row, never emitted.
- Claims land on the `agenda_item:` subject and additionally on a
  `contract:` subject when the matter type matches `contract_matter_patterns`.

### Idempotency — two real defects found live and fixed

1. **Byte-volatile captures churned claim digests** (+328 on the first
   deployed eScribe re-run): `evidence.capture_digest` keyed the claim's
   `content_digest`, and `Meeting.aspx` embeds churning CSRF/viewstate bytes.
   Capture id left the claim evidence dict (the OKC convention); the
   capture↔document map moved to the `agenda_document` row and the new
   `FetchRecord.document_outcomes` — durable per-document provenance in every
   run row.
2. **eScribe's index ordering is random per call** (+14 on the next re-run):
   `GetCalendarMeetings` returned the same 474-meeting set with 465/474
   positions shuffled between two fetches 45s apart, sliding the
   position-based window. `doc_order_fields` now ranks the window by item
   data (date desc, id tie-break) — a function of the item *set*.

**Proof:** eScribe runs C→D on the final image selected an **identical
300-document window** (`document_outcomes` URL sets equal, 269 no_match /
31 matched both runs) and added **0 claim rows**.

### Plumbing

- `pipeline.py` `RunReport.drifted`; `runner.py` `FetchRecord.document_drift`
  + `document_outcomes` + `SourceRunReport.drifted`; `ops/scheduled.py`
  surfaces drift in the run-row detail.
- `ops/gcp/scheduled-ops.sh`: ingest task timeout 30m→60m (the bounded window
  over ~300 tenants exceeded the old ceiling — CivicClerk hit it; applied to
  all four agenda jobs for real).

### Tests

`tests/connectors/test_agenda_documents.py` — 23 tests over new committed
fixtures (Legistar matter JSON, CivicClerk events+meeting JSON, eScribe
meeting HTML, PrimeGov portal HTML, a CCTV agenda PDF): bounds-as-data, all
four platforms, PDF page locators, verbatim `raw_value` verified at the
locator range, genre drift per-document, empty/refused/gone outcomes,
set-stable window selection under shuffled index order, Part VIII guards.
